title: Lime & Chilli Dressing
description: A quick 5-minute dressing of lime juice, hot sauce, garlic and cumin with a Mexican-inspired kick.
steps: Mix all ingredients in a small bowl.
notes: Pairs with Smoky Mexican Black Bean Sweet Potato Stew, Fiesta Beef, Flaming Fajita Traybake, and the Mexican-style Bounty Bowl.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
